meta.title: Improve Racket backend formatting
meta.body_summary: Apply raco fmt to generated Racket code and update compiler golden files accordingly, improving readability and consistency of the generated backend output.

perf_labels.notes: Large formatting-only change (14-line compiler tweak + autoformatted golden files); merged instantly by maintainer with zero review, reflecting extreme trust and low-risk perception.

change_scale_vs_repository.interpretation: At 2605 changed lines this is a large diff by volume, but 99.5% are regenerated test golden files from formatting; the actual source change is only 14 lines in the compiler, making it effectively a small, risk-free maintenance task that merged instantly.

review_details.performance_claim: Improved generated Racket code readability and consistency via pretty-printing with raco fmt.

capability_boundary.boundary_notes: Formatting and golden-test regeneration is a low-risk automation that the maintainer trusted fully; the agent succeeded without any human barrier because the change was mechanical and well-understood.

maintainer_practices.reproducibility_notes: No performance benchmark or profiler evidence provided; the PR only asserts formatting improvements and updates golden files without measurable runtime data.

core_change_summary.description: In compile/x/rkt/compiler.go, added a call to raco fmt to format generated Racket code; regenerated 33 golden output files under tests/compiler/rkt/ to reflect the new formatting style.
core_change_summary.secondary_note: All 33 golden output files were updated mechanically by the test regeneration command; no logic changes in outputs, only formatting.
change_trajectory: Single commit: 'feat(rkt): format generated code' by tamnd adds raco fmt call and regenerates all affected golden files.

collaboration_trajectory: PR opened by maintainer tamnd (user) with one commit, labeled 'codex'; merged within ~2.3 minutes with no review or comments.
